title: JetLagged
tagline: Turn your travel anxiety into profit. Bet on flight delays and cancellations.
description:
A decentralized prediction market platform built on Celo and Oasis where users can bet on flight delays and cancellations. Built with Next.js, Bun.js, Solidity, and deployed on Celo blockchain.

- Live Flight Markets: Bet on real flights with live odds
- Real-Time Pricing: AMM-based pricing that updates based on market demand
- Decentralized Resolution: Automated flight status verification via Oasis backend oracle
- Farcaster Integration: Works as a Farcaster Frame mini-app
- Celo Blockchain: Fast, low-cost transactions on Celo network
how_its_made:
1. Smart Contracts

   - Solidity contracts for prediction markets
   - AMM-based pricing mechanism
   - Deployed on Celo mainnet and Sepolia testnet

2. Backend Resolver

   - Uses Oasis TEE
   - Bun.js REST API
   - Fetches real-time flight data from Aviation Edge API
   - Resolves markets on-chain
   - Dockerized for easy deployment

3. Frontend - Celo mini app
   - Next.js 14 with App Router
   - Wagmi + Viem for blockchain interactions
   - Farcaster Frame integration
   - Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui components
